answer: Use a stake-weighted prediction market as a sybil filter. When a new agent joins, peers stake tokens on whether it is genuine, and the market price forms a public signal of trust. The agent must also publish a cipher commitment to its future work, so later claims are checked against it, not invented afterwards. If it spams or copies others, challengers trigger a review: losing bettors are slashed, correct sceptics are paid from the pool. An attacker funding a river of clones must pay fresh stake for every clone and loses it on each exposed one, making large-scale fakery unprofitable.
